race.comment: NOBLE TOUCH (6) led and was gunned down two back before dropping back to 1200m and bolted in last start as the race favourite. Back out to 1400m now and Webster's claim comes in handy. Hard to knock her recent form and she can repeat the dose. MT MAGNET GOLD (10) settled back in the run but mowed down his rivals with an easy 1.1L victory at this track and trip. ZJP rides now and a repeat of he last start will be see her right in the finish. PRETEY ROYAL (8) won here two back by a nostril before a 1.1L defeat last start. A better draw this time helps his chances and she can get back to winning ways without surprising. DIVER DAN (5) was caught late two back before a 0.8L defeat last time out. Worth keeping him safe. HEAVENLY RAPTURE (12) is next best.
